objective: Client wants a price for a 1.8 m high timber paling fence along a 40 m rear boundary of a house in Auckland, with the old fence taken down and removed.

scope.item: 1.8 m high timber paling fence with old fence removal
scope.unitText: complete fence job along the rear boundary
inclusions: Supply and install 1.8 m high timber paling fence
Take down and remove old fence
assumptions: Fence follows the full 40 m rear boundary
clarifications: Timber type, paling style, post and rail specification, and finish
Access, ground conditions, and disposal requirements

objective: What does it cost to replace the carpet in a 150 m2 office with luxury vinyl plank flooring, including lifting the old carpet and preparing the floor?

scope.item: Replace office carpet with luxury vinyl plank flooring
inclusions: Prepare the floor for new flooring
Supply and install luxury vinyl plank flooring
assumptions: Price is for the full 150 m² office floor area.
clarifications: Extent of floor preparation and any repairs
Whether furniture moving and skirting or trim work are required

objective: Tenant wants to know what Chorus will charge to bring fibre into a new six-unit light industrial building.

scope.item: Chorus fibre connection to a new six-unit light industrial building
inclusions: Chorus charges to bring fibre to the building
exclusions: Internal cabling and fit-out within the building
assumptions: Price the building-level connection, not six separate tenant connections
clarifications: Whether Chorus charges separately for each unit
Whether civil works or reinstatement are included
Whether the connection is a standard service or requires network extension
